criteria: Feature review explicitly distinguishes explanation/observations from actionable conflict/ambiguity and required developer input at the existing Critic and Product owner. Aligned observations are usable; accept plus material conflict blocks. Missing, malformed, contradictory and uncertain assessments fail closed; no keyword matching or blanket ignoring of findings.

The existing eeaf9e6 host-collected developer-answer contract remains authoritative. Ordinary approval, agent Decision text, project-write and nested tool authority cannot supply that answer. Warning, actual response and revision context are durable.

A developer can accept an actual charter, accept an aligned Feature, derive an inert complete US, edit and accept the US, and reopen to the same exact definitions and revisions through real public paths. Feature enables US and Product contains Feature remain graph-owned. No universal Feature/Epic parent is imposed.

The exact canonical required US fields are checked and represented, with complete episode and expected result sufficient to derive tests without inventing behavior; preserve identities, legacy data and existing schema. Definition acceptance is separate from implementation verification.

Feature and UserStory acceptance/revision consult the current accepted Product charter. Missing charter and stale revisions refuse, rejection/cancellation are inert, and charter amendment invalidates pending review without silently rewriting accepted definitions.
One canonical Feature identity/revision underlies detail and exported Manifest, with canonical relations. No shadow registry, database, critic framework or product authority is introduced.

Regression tests prove a meaningful unchanged public journey and adverse outcomes using controlled external transport, with real red-before-green evidence. Existing tests retain their assertions; mandatory charter/reviewer fixture setup changes are justified, never weakened enforcement.

Apply the Prime Directive to whole touched methods/artifacts and immediate contracts, including placement, purpose, statement tightness, execution flow and justified generality; find material defects with exact causal evidence. Advanced Aspects/Epic inheritance/Sub-US/impact, Radar, provider infrastructure and task 3 remain out of scope.

Validation and live claims are truthful. Live o3-mini classified both Features; final output handling changed after a refusal-path defect was observed. Exact final external responses were replayed successfully against the final handler; this is controlled replay, not another live run. Independently assess whether this provides adequate semantic and whole-scope acceptance evidence; report any exact remaining qualification blocker.
No native VERIFY receipt, Ticket Done or higher-stage acceptance is claimed. Assess this bounded implementation and public behavior independently of Ticket lanes and aggregate counts.
